text:
Alex R: Pushed a draft dashboard PR for the Dedicated capacity scan. It combines token-level latency breakdowns, per-route KPIs, kernel selection heatmap, batching distribution, and per-pool KV cache metrics. PTAL before I promote to staging. https://git.redwood/dashboard/PR-472 :eyes:

Samir: On it. Quick Q — how are we computing 'headroom' for a pool? Is it based on sustained p95 throughput vs committed GPUs or estimated burst?

Alex R: headroom = committed_tps - observed_rolling_1m_tps at p95 load. We also surface a conservative headroom that uses model-bound kernels and 99th token latency SLO.

Maya: Noticed in the profiler yesterday that pool-gamma shows KV cache thrash when kernel_selector picks the fp16 matmul kernel for long sequences. Hit-rate drops ~12% when sequence > 1024 and batching spikes. Might be batching interplay.

Tessa: Related — I flagged a perf-regression in the nightly run: kernel_selector favors v2-kernel on ~10% of requests that used to go to v1. v2 gives lower tail latency sometimes but blows up CPU pre-processing for short sequences. Logs attached in the PR.

Samir: Can you paste the PromQL you used for the token-level breakdown? Want to replicate for pool-gamma only.

Alex R: sure — snippet below (panel "token_latency_by_stage"):

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, stage, pool, route))
```

Alex R: And KV hitrate panel uses: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (pool)`

Maya: I ran a quick tail test on pool-gamma with seq=1536 and batch=8; KV hitrate dropped to 64%. With batch=4 it stays ~78%. We should consider auto-shrink batching when sequence > 1024 for that pool.

Tessa: If kernel_selector picks v2-kernel for those short sequences we should also force quantized path where available. There's an option `kernel_force_quant=true` in the runtime flags for the pool. Can we try that on a canary?

eng-analytics: Dashboard notes — added per-route SLA columns (p50/p90/p99 tokens, avg tokens/request), and a 'noisy-neighbor index' computed as zscore of per-pool token latency delta vs cluster median. Threshold defaults: z>2.5 is noisy.

Samir: zscore is fine, but let's make thresholds configurable per-tenant. For some high-throughput pools z=1.8 already causes customer-facing impact.

Alex R: noted. For the rollout plan: 1) merge PR to staging (visual only), 2) enable extra panels for pool-gamma in canary, 3) run 30m replay load, 4) if KV hitrate drop >10% or noisy-index >2, rollback and flip batching heuristic to `adaptive: conservative` for that pool.

Maya: I'll run the replay and share load artifacts. Putting a quick command here: `./bench/replay --pool pool-gamma --seq 1536 --batch 8 --duration 1800 --tag kv-thrash-test`

Tessa: I'll prepare a hotfix to force quantized kernel for short seqs and a config toggle `runtime.pool.<pool>.batching.mode=conservative` so we can flip without deploy.

Alex R: Awesome. Can we also add a tiny panel that shows kernel selection counts by pool (stacked bar) — useful to see sudden shifts. Panel id: kernel_selector_breakdown.

eng-analytics: Added to the PR. Also added annotation rule: if kernel_selector_breakdown changes >15% for any kernel within 5m, create an alert with context linking to the last 3 autoscaler events.

Samir: :thumbsup: Let's aim to promote to staging today. If Maya's replay reproduces the KV thrash we'll go with conservative batching for pool-gamma and keep the new panels in read-only mode until SRE approves.

Maya: Replay queued. Will post results in ~40m.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Dashboard PR 472 merged to staging by Alex R at 1798801392

Alex R: Thanks all. Follow-up checklist: (a) Maya posts replay output, (b) Tessa preps quantized kernel toggle PR, (c) Samir tunes noisy-index per-tenant values. I'll open a short runbook snippet in the PR for on-call to follow when noisy-index fires.

Tessa: I'll tag SRE for a quick look after I open the toggle PR.

Maya: Replay results: peak tps ~ 420, avg kv_hitrate=65% during high-seq window, noisy-index=2.9 for pool-gamma, kernel shift: v2-kernel went from 8%->38%. Attaching flamegraphs and a small CSV.

Samir: That's pretty conclusive. Recommend immediate conservative batching flip for pool-gamma and schedule a follow-up to investigate why kernel_selector started preferring v2 — maybe a model weight or metadata change.

Alex R: Agreed. I'll flip batching.mode to conservative for pool-gamma and add the config change to the PR description so it's auditable. Deploying change to staging now.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Configuration change applied to staging for pool-gamma at 1798801602 by Alex R

eng-analytics: After the flip, observed kv_hitrate back to 79% and noisy-index down to 1.1 in 10m window. p99 token latency unchanged for low-seq routes, improved for long-seq ones.

Samir: Nice. Closing loop: we'll keep the kernel heatmap + kernel_selector_breakdown panel live and add a periodic offline job that computes drift of kernel preference per-model. Create ticket?

Alex R: Created ticket INF-2143 and linked it in the PR. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
